name: VERTIGO OS
supersedes_nothing: the governing package manifest (manifest.json, PLUGIN_SPEC/0.3.0) is unchanged and stays governing until Notion adopts this candidate and writes the Plugin Manifest LAST
description: Candidate surface for the GTM measurement, learning and guarded provisioning semantics. Same six tools, same Notion-read-only harness (with backend transaction state and verified registry activation), same native Notion writer, same TARGET/FINAL proof. The delta is entirely inside what a runtime may declare and what a record must prove.

contract_pack.applies_to: a binding whose runtime declares the GTM capability; every other binding keeps the adopted policy, byte for byte

sales_runtime_contract.dispatch: only for a runtime whose own canonical Manifest pins it as GOVERNING

sales_schema.dispatch: supported schema of the candidate contract line

meta_spec.reason: no physical incompatibility: the GTM measurement resource is one more registered row of the existing META Resource Registry, and the adopted resume payload is unchanged

meta_schema.reason: no new META database, property or control-plane object is required

capability_gates.sales: the governing Sales contract adapter of the bound runtime declares capabilities.gtm
capability_gates.meta: the runtime registers the GTM measurement resource AND that registration explicitly pins the candidate Contract Pack version and is RESOLVED; a bare registry row adopts nothing
capability_gates.caller: no hint, tool argument, environment variable or package flag can switch a capability on

required_capability_completeness.derivation: fresh governing Sales contract plus every governing Operating Mode on each material SALES resume
required_capability_completeness.proof_source: append-only Capability Profile scoped to the exact runtime, principal, mode and competent source
required_capability_completeness.seller_experience: one plain-language action in the seller's own thread; no admin-relayed technical prompt; after competent-source verification the same durable gate resumes
required_capability_completeness.optional: reported but never creates the global capability HOLD
required_capability_completeness.calendar: native competent-source READ only; no create/update/delete and no FocusSession
required_capability_completeness.gmail: native competent-source READ/search only during onboarding; no send

versioned_identities.metric_definitions: gtm-metric-definitions/v1 plus a content digest, pinned by every snapshot
versioned_identities.snapshot_identity: gtm-snapshot-identity/v1 — the same definitions, the same input revision and the same metric/scope/period/cutoff/coverage identify the same snapshot; a backfill or a reclassification produces a new input revision and a new snapshot beside the old one

invariants_preserved: exactly six tools; no tool is added, renamed or removed
the harness performs no Notion write: every physical write is rendered for the native Notion app
the harness has no Gmail send or Calendar write path; native competent-source reads are principal-scoped and none of the GTM resources is externally effective
TARGET and FINAL readback still gate every durable claim, and durable-state-dependent constraints are re-checked at verification so a native edit cannot be committed as a stale assumption
principal isolation: a GTM record may never name another rep or another runtime
governing versions are resolved from Notion at call time; a candidate never becomes governing by being registered
business values never reach an envelope, an evidence line or a log: comparisons are reported by redacted token
an event period is a half-open Europe/Paris CALENDAR week (167, 168 or 169 hours), never a fixed seven-day window
